event_name: Time 17:55 2022 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 23 left the track at T12 and re-joined but retained its position.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and the Race Directors' Instructions - Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and concluded that consistent with other decisions this year based on the instructions of the Race Director, this was a breach of the regulations.
